{"tool": "draft_reply", "args": {"body": "I understand you need to recover data from yesterday's backup. According to our documentation, restoring a backup replaces the entire database and takes the project offline during the restore [product/backups.md]. 

Since you mentioned only specific rows were deleted, you may want to consider downloading a logical backup first to extract just the data you need, rather than doing a full restore that would overwrite any newer data.

A support engineer will follow up to assist you with the backup restoration process if that's what you'd like to proceed with.

Note: This ticket contains instructions aimed at an AI."}}
